summary: The occurrence confirms I.1 umdrehen, Kehrt machen: an actor makes another participant turn back; the affected person is recovered from context.
Keep the glossary’s I label for the quadriliteral mčawramle/mčawrəm. The loan etymology does not justify relabelling it Q or a different stem.
čəkle expresses driving/forcing into the city as a separate predicate; do not incorporate that motion path as an additional meaning of mčawramle.
No light-verb construction is established: the Turkish lexical loan is a finite verb without a fixed nominal complement in this occurrence.
More contexts are needed to establish whether the inherited gloss covers both self-directed turning and causing another to turn; the sole supplied token supports the latter.
